_note: Qualification set for the fast route (owner order §10, 26 September 2026). Written after the router's rules were frozen and separate from the fixture the rules were built on (packages/policy/tests/fixtures/light_conversation_cases.json) and from the held-out fixture; no phrase here appears in either, except the five examples the order itself names as must-not-fast-route (kept because the order names them) and the resumed pairs whose joined form is a fixture case. `A || B` is spoken as two stretches with a pause between them (the resume case). The 'ineligible' group spans both boundaries: light wording that carries work, and work that opens with a pleasantry. Recognition is by Whisper on a synthetic voice; the transcript, not the phrase, is what the router saw, and each turn is judged on the transcript.
